_comment: Base hyperparameters. Only depth and the intervention/loss vary across ablation arms (matched-budget principle). Tune lr/n_hidden/heads via validation AUPRC before the final runs.
_drop_rate_note: DropEdge proportion. Treated as an experimental factor: sweep {0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5}. NOT a fixed literature value (addresses supervisor point 6 on unjustified thresholds).
_smote_note: Edge-SMOTE oversamples minority by this multiple; sweep {0.5, 1.0, 2.0}.
_focal_note: Defaults from Lin, T. Y. et al. (2017).
_cb_note: Class-balanced beta from Cui et al. (2019); beta->1 approaches inverse-frequency weighting.
_threshold_note: Operating threshold chosen on VALIDATION to reach this precision, applied unchanged to test.
